name: leeway
description: A free, self-hosted budget tracker with bank sync, account alerts, and a secure MCP link for your AI assistant.
author: David Engel

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspaces && npm run test:scripts -- --coverage
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p widget && tsc -p scripts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
